streamingReadinessProbe.observation: Loading had already cleared by post-oracle inspection in both variants. Mutation-idle gaps alone were insufficient to establish readiness.
streamingReadinessProbe.resolution: The benchmark now waits for the table loading indicator to finish its leave transition before counting stable frames. Clearing aria-busy alone is insufficient because the leaving indicator remains in the DOM. The remaining six no-smoothing cases use this gate; all earlier retained runs passed the same strict static equality check.
